name: Short frozen-warm-policy estimator and shadow-admission qualification
status: IMPLEMENTED FOR ESTIMATOR REVIEW; local fixtures pass; no warmed load or root cohort run
question: Can the proposed importance-corrected check/call exploration give missing passive histories positive-weight learning under an already warmed policy, rather than just visit zero-target-reach branches?

warm.sigma: current regret-matching policy from the checkpoint, NOT the exported average
warm.readonly: load existing checkpoint in place, do not copy/unfreeze/resume/rewrite. Membership and every regret/average stay unchanged.
warm.missing: uniform over exact legal menu; this is the warm-policy reference at an absent key

fixtures: enumerate all sampled paths of fixed small games to compare expectations of every regret and opponent-sampled average increment, including sigma(passive)=0
test zero-prefix, suffix ratios, all-tied utilities, underflow versus exact zero, check/call menu labels and duplicate raise removal
q>=0.75*sigma, float64, no clipping/self-normalization; positive-product underflow is a numerical failure, not a legitimate zero weight
disabled proposal preserves old sampler/updates; tiny1/2/8/16-thread deterministic ledger/delta parity and changed-source/config refusals

root_work.pairing: same fresh domain-separated deal/root-path uniforms in both modes; balanced256traverser contexts per seat; each root is a separate sampled deal
root_work.fixed_sigma: keep warmed sigma fixed for every traversal; never feed accumulated diagnostic deltas back into policy
root_work.weights: multiply returned child values by sigma/q; prefix products correct both regret and existing opponent-sampled average updates; linear iteration weights separately recorded

saved_prefix_audit.selection: first64 declared blocks in each PR41310B initial field, both turn and river when reached; fixed before qualification outcomes
saved_prefix_audit.operation: reconstruct historical legal prefixes, calculate each non-traverser action probability under current warmed sigma and q, and their cumulative counterfactual reach. This is likelihood inspection, not forced-action strength replay.
saved_prefix_audit.why: never restart at the missing state with weight1: a zero-probability earlier opponent action makes its counterfactual prefix weight zero
saved_prefix_audit.outputs: target missing keys with all observed prefixes, legal history/family, exact-zero ancestor reason and positive reach. Original private data stays evaluator-owned; only legal actor observations enter policy queries.

shadow_admission.purpose: research-only prospective admission ledger for missing warm-table keys. The actual250Mtable remains frozen, so this is not evidence that it can admit additional rows.
shadow_admission.rule: merge all deltas at the same full32-root batch boundary, including zero updates, and freeze shadow membership on crossing100K; report whole-batch overshoot. Continue remaining fixed batches, counting discarded updates.
shadow_admission.no_zero_shortcut: do not skip zero-prefix descendants or suppress zero-delta entries: quantify whether the proposed ordinary admission rule wastes slots. No filtered-admission variant is added.
shadow_admission.tracking: for admitted keys and fixed watched missing keys: first encounter, admission, exact-zero/positive coefficients, per-action regret/average deltas, distinct root IDs, weighted sums/squares, and post-freeze discards
states: encountered only at zero target weight
positive coefficients but all-zero numerical updates
zero at admission but later positive
shadow_admission.useful_proxy: replicated positive learning: previously missing key has positive accumulated average contribution, at least one nonzero counterfactual regret contribution, at least4distinctpositive-weight root contexts, and root-grouped ESS>=4. Report turn/river and history families separately.
shadow_admission.limitation: this proxy establishes usable update evidence, not improved action values, deployment quality, full-model coverage or from-scratch admission success

measurements.zero_weights: exact-zero fraction at sampled actions, whole prefixes and update coefficients, by street/family/mode; numerical underflow and tie-induced zero deltas separate
measurements.ess: Kish ESS=(sum w)^2/sum(w^2), zero if denominator0. Report event-level and grouped-by-independent-root weights separately, prefix-average and terminal/value coefficients separately, with/without linear iteration weight; never use signed regrets/payoffs as weights.
measurements.dependence: within-root tree branches are correlated. Event ESS is only a concentration diagnostic; root-grouped ESS is still not a strength interval or independent decision count.
measurements.admission: new/positive/replicated-learning rows per1Mvisited nodes and per1000root contexts; zero-update share of shadow slots at admission, freeze and endpoint; useful updates discarded after freeze
measurements.matched_watch: all selected saved-prefix targets retained, including never reached during stochastic traversals; do not silently drop zero/no-hit targets
measurements.runtime: actual hashes/load/traversal/prefix/ledger/proof/report CPU/wall/RAM/bytes and thermal cost separately

decision.correctness: any biased fixture expectation, zero-prefix ghost update, illegal observation, nonfinite/underflow or reproduction mismatch fails qualification; retain and stop
decision.mechanism: report whether any missing turn AND river keys meet the replicated-positive-learning proxy. If none do, distinguish proven zero target reach from insufficient sampling; neither is a10Blaunch recommendation.
decision.promising: positive repeated learning can justify a separately priced next experiment only; no automatic training, epsilon tuning, row filter or changed objective

components.component: isolated build and focused target-host checks
source/model/K50 pins and file identity checks
fixed prefix audit plus two-mode root traversals, both passes
hash reproduction and complete ledger verification

compute.assumption: cold10Bload is scaled from historical3Bresume startup residual; not an observed load time for this new tool

storage.reproducibility: Initial outputs retained; separate-process repeat byte-compares and hashes emitted bytes against the initial stream, retaining only receipts/timings and first-mismatch chunk context.
storage.note: Fresh 12GiB new-space admission required; recorded snapshots do not reserve space. No model copy, checkpoint rewrite, export or arena trace tree.

engineering_estimate: approximately one working day for isolated diagnostic traversal, fixtures and review; production trainer and release recipe remain untouched
launch_status: No mature or short warmed run launched. Source-bound estimator review, target-host build/fixtures and fresh admission required.
